newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - June 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - June 16.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on June 16. Reuters has not verified these stories and does notvouch for their accuracy.

The chairman of the fragmented Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI), Surjadi, has said he plans to lead the party, whose vote share plunged in the May 29 general elections due to internal conflict, until the next congress in 1998. Surjadi was earlier reportedly planning to resign following the party's poor performance in the elections.

Twenty-six people have been arrested in fresh rioting in Bangkalan on Madura island on Saturday night when rioters set fire to a church, a Buddish temple, a cinema, three shops and three government vehicles.

General Motors Buana Indonesia (GMBI) is expected to produce a Cadillac sedan in Indonesia early next year. GMBI is a joint venture between General Motors of the United States and PT Mercu Buana, which produces Opel Cadillac and Chevrolet cars.

The government has said it will go ahead with its plan to merge seven state-owned banks into four in order to boost the efficiency and competitiveness in the global market. The banks are BDN, BNI, BRI, BTN, Bapindo, Bank Exim and Bank Exim.
